title: ResourcePolicy
description: Intent-level resource processing policy. It carries only resource, tier, and persist. Mechanism knobs such as OCR engine, chunking, caching, conversion toggles, or redaction options are structurally impossible.

resource.description: Attachment entity or registered resource_id to process. Bare attachments on plain messages bypass processing and resolve to direct. Attachments on messages with redaction present inherit that redaction boundary and cannot resolve below secure.

oneOf.description: Registered resource_id for a previously stored resource.

tier.description: Requested processing tier. Null derives from the carrying message: plain message -> direct, redacted message -> secure. The secure floor is un-bypassable: direct or indexed on a redacted message is a validation error in that message context.

persist.description: Whether to keep durable derived artifacts and a warmed per-resource thread. Null means the resource plane applies the smart default for the resolved tier and binding context.
